execution_rule: One collection/resume against this frozen manifest, one signal-blind validation, then one automatic score only on matching PASS. Otherwise stop UNRESOLVED; no alternate outputs, data patches or new criteria.
limitations: Corporate-action history depth and delay bound are undocumented; quarterly dividend presence is a sanity check, not completeness certification.
A split or vendor adjustment absent from supplied data/documentation can remain undetected.
Missing/empty cash-payout currency is explicitly assumed USD and counted; non-USD is unresolved.
The manual vendor-adjustment review is bounded documentation evidence, not proof that no undocumented change exists.
Page-body hashes preserve fingerprints but raw bodies are not retained; stored chunk file bytes are rehashed.
Claim is per collection directory and a crash after claim prevents retry; the approval names one directory.
Bar-price proxy performance cannot certify executable fills, MOC availability or live suitability.
